arguments.body:
July 2023’s owner-lane arrangement established a historical allocation of responsibility for that period. It is evidence of who owned which lanes then—not proof that the same ownership, decision rights, or escalation paths apply today.

When interpreting current investigation readouts, use the July arrangement as historical context only. Do not treat it as establishing present-day governance or as evidence that a particular team had authority beyond its assigned lane.

args.title: July owner lanes — historical interpretation guardrail
args.body:
July 2023’s owner-lane arrangement established a historical allocation of responsibility for that period. It is evidence of who owned which lanes then—not proof that the same ownership, decision rights, or escalation paths apply today.

When interpreting current investigation readouts, use the July arrangement as historical context only. Do not treat it as establishing present-day governance or as evidence that a particular team had authority beyond its assigned lane.
